title: solverDict
description: Numerics of a steady case (system/solverDict, optional; read by choupoSolve only). Top level: the tear list, the recycle numerics (a recycle is a fixed-point problem; the rungs are directSubstitution with a relaxation factor, Wegstein, Newton on the tears) and one block per unit-op type. Any other key is REFUSED by name (DEV.md 4c C246).

tearStreams.description: The streams the recycle iteration cuts.

recycleSolver.description: Newton on the tears (default), Wegstein (per-variable adaptive relaxation, w = 1 - q), the dominant-eigenvalue aid, or plain direct substitution (optionally relaxed by recycleRelaxation).

recycleMaxIter.description: Maximum passes of the tear loop.

recycleWegsteinQmin.description: Lower clamp of Wegstein's q (q = 1 - w; q = -1 is a doubled step).

recycleWegsteinQmax.description: Upper clamp of Wegstein's q (0 = never under-relax).

recycleRelaxation.description: Fixed relaxation factor w of x+ = (1-w) x + w G(x). Only with recycleSolver directSubstitution; refused with any other solver and outside (0, 1]. Announced when declared.

recycleMaxStep.description: Newton on the tears: no tear unknown moves more than this fraction of its own scale in one step. Absent = no cap. Announced when declared.

ColumnNewton.description: Newton knobs of the simultaneous MESH. lineSearch none = the legacy Newton, the same choice as the operation's `newton legacy;` (declare it once; both at once is refused). maxStepT / maxStepX cap the bounded Newton and are refused with lineSearch none.

maxStepT.description: Largest stage-temperature change per Newton step.

maxStepX.description: Largest mole-fraction change per Newton step.

CstrNewton.description: Newton knobs of the multi-reaction CSTR.

maxStepExtent.description: An extent moves at most this fraction of the feed flow per Newton step.
